(4) The migration-0010 DB guards fire on API-written rows: version step, immutable columns, the deferred audit-required constraint and append-only charter_version.

summary: Verdict FAIL on candidate b98c44db (source 9e13947e). The round-3 changes cause no regression: static checks, unit tests (Node 22 and 24), integration ×2 (19 migrations, 161 ops), the earlier QA suites ×2 and the full e2e ×2 (46/46, EN and AR, axe clean on the journeys) all pass. New independent checks pass too: a 116-probe D-063 sweep, F-DG2-150 blocking a G1 submission, and the DB guards. The assignment's own negative UI check fails in EN and AR. The web never shows the localized blank message, because RecordForm turns whitespace into null, so a blank save creates a charter or a content-free version, or clears an existing Out of scope (F-DG2-210, Medium). axe also finds a serious 'listitem' violation in the RecordForm error banner (F-DG2-211, Medium, pre-existing). No data-integrity failure: blank text is never stored.
narrative: All 32 requirements were exercised with evidence; the remaining gaps are the two UI findings. Neither finding is Critical, High or mandatory. The FAIL verdict follows from two checks the assignment requires (QA-R3-19 and QA-R3-20) that did not pass, and a PASS review cannot contain a failing check. Suggested repair: send whitespace-only text from RecordForm text fields, or validate it client-side with validation__blank, and don't write a charter version when no field changed; move role="alert" off the <ul>. Then re-run docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/qa/tests/round-3/e2e/dg2-qa-blank-r3.spec.ts. The new QA tests sit under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/qa/tests/round-3/ (frozen candidate) for promotion to tests/qa/ and e2e/; docs/ is prettier-ignored, so run prettier on promotion. HEAD moved from 6245903 to f5f22f2 during the run (other reviewers' evidence and a round-4 assignment); the candidate ID was unchanged and those records were not read.
